projects.title: Zelda Classic / ZQuest Classic game engine
projects.description:
https://zquestclassic.com/

I'm a core developer of a C++ game engine that has had 1000+ games made with it. It specializes in creating 2d games similar to the original Zelda, but allows for full customization of all graphics, sounds, and game behavior with a custom scripting language.

Some large projects I've done on it include:

- Ported to the web (https://hoten.cc/blog/porting-zelda-classic-to-the-web/ - this reached #1 on HackerNews https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=31251004)
- Ported to Mac and Linux
- Added a "record/replay" system for exhaustive pixel-perfect regression testing, along with dozens of other tests, to a 20+ year old project with no previous automated tests. This has accelerated feature development and prevented many bug regressions
- Added a JIT compiler for the engine's custom scripting language, which resulted in 5-20x improvements
- Many modernization efforts to make the codebase more maintainable and secure
- 2 years into a large rewrite to make the engine more flexible with free-form scrolling, while not breaking a single of the 1000+ existing games
- Countless bug fixes, features added, and assisting other developers on the project
- Developed the website / maintain the infra for release management
